responses.persona: A 34-year-old yoga instructor who rarely drinks soda. She reads ingredient labels carefully and is wary of artificial flavoring. She would need a compelling reason to try any soft drink.

responses.name: David

answers.most_appealing: The idea of a soda with no sugar and zero calories is appealing, but it's just marketing trying to sell me something I don't need.
